text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Ward Councillor has requested operating conditions be imposed on the boulevard café permit located at 511 Danforth Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the application for the proposed boulevard café permit located at 511 Danforth Avenue. 2. Directed Municipal Licensing and Standards staff to report to the Toronto and East York Community Council in one year on any operational issues.
